picks.excerpt: MIT Technology Review pulls together what cognitive research now says about offloading thinking to chatbots: the measurable effects on memory, attention and the feeling of understanding. It is the clearest current read on what daily AI use does to human cognition.
picks.rationale: The best single synthesis of what cognitive science actually measures when people offload thinking to chatbots — directly about the reader's own daily tool use.

picks.excerpt: When LLMs rewrite text they cut variation in writing complexity by 21-50% while keeping meaning intact. Models reading the rewritten passages became six percentage points worse at inferring the author's personal traits - a warning for language-based psychological assessment.
picks.rationale: Quantifies the cost of letting a model polish your words: meaning survives, but 21-50% of stylistic variation and much of the personal signal does not.

picks.excerpt: A new theory of predictive categorization describes how brains throw away most sensory detail and keep only what predicts the future. The framing maps directly onto how representation learning in neural networks is understood.
picks.rationale: A fresh theory of how brains discard detail and keep only what predicts — the cleanest biological framing yet for what representation learning is doing.

picks.excerpt: A Complexity Science Hub benchmark tested 22 large language models on who they name as an expert. The models did not merely mirror existing inequality - they amplified it, under-representing women and scholars from under-represented backgrounds.
picks.rationale: A reusable benchmark across 22 models showing that asking an LLM 'who is the expert here' amplifies rather than mirrors existing inequality.

picks.excerpt: MIT researchers combined density functional theory with machine learning to screen transition-metal nitride alloys for electrochemical ammonia synthesis. The computational screen replaces trial-and-error catalyst search for one of chemistry's largest carbon footprints.
picks.rationale: DFT plus machine learning narrows the catalyst search for electrochemical ammonia, one of the largest carbon footprints in industrial chemistry.
